d: Jannik Sinner’s Six Kings Slam decision has started a debate about money, injuries and priorities in professional tennis. After announcing that his 2026 season was over because of knee inflammation and withdrawing from key tournaments, the Italian confirmed his participation in the rescheduled Saudi Arabia exhibition, where the winner stands to earn $6 million. Sinner hasn't played professional tennis since his Wimbeldon 2026 win over Carlos Alcaraz. Rupha Ramani examines Jannik Sinner, the Six Kings Slam, Saudi Arabia’s growing role in tennis, exhibition prize money and the scrutiny…
